devtools::load_all()

The `img` class is a helper to insert an external image. It replaces `officer::external_img`.


## Supported formats

## Examples

```{r}
#| echo: true
#| 
file_out <- tempfile(fileext = ".pptx")
file_png <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")

png(file_png, bg = "transparent")
  plot(0:10/10, col = "red", pch = 16, cex = 3)
  # title(tools::file_ext(file_png))
dev.off()

x <- read_pptx() |> layout_default("Title and Content")

# default settings
x <- x |> add_slide(title = "img() - defaults", body = img(file_png))

# img() settings
x <- x |> add_slide(title = "img() - with settings",
                    body = img(file_png, h_just = 0, line = "blue", background = "lightblue", scale = .9))

# settings via ph_with()
x <- x |>
  add_slide(title = "img() - with settings") |>
  ph_with(img(file_png), "body", line = sp_line(lwd = 4, color = "red", lty = "dash"),
          background = "#ffdddd", rotation = 90)

# via phs_with() ---
# TODO: This is wrong
x <- x |>
  add_slide() |>
  phs_with(body = img(file_png, scale = 1), 
           body = img(file_png, scale = .5)) #, v_just = .5, h_just = .5)) |>
  #phs_with(fullsize = img(file_png, scale = .5, v_just = 0, h_just = 0))

print(x, file_out)
# file_open(file_out)
```
